## Grading {#grading}

Everything is out of **100 marks**.

```{=html}
<table class="t" data-quarto-disable-processing="true">
<thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Marks</th><th>How</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><th>Quizzes</th><td class="big">40</td><td>Four quizzes, 10 marks each.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Lab exams</th><td class="big">20</td><td>Two lab exams, 10 marks each.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Project</th><td class="big">20</td><td>In groups of four. <a href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1eVVmBrCTXHa6XhfewG2S9_if11Ija0s_cNMBp5NMbww/edit?usp=sharing">Project ideas</a>.</td></tr>
<tr><th>End semester</th><td class="big">10</td><td>Written exam. There is no mid-semester exam.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Homework</th><td class="big">8</td><td>Two individual programming assignments.</td></tr>
<tr><th>OS zine</th><td class="big">2</td><td>A zine in the style of <a href="https://jvns.ca/zines/">Julia Evans's zines</a>.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Total</th><td class="big">100</td><td>Scores are revised only if a question was left unchecked or the marks were totalled incorrectly.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
```

:::
